choices.content: Have the teacher choose 5 students considered representative
Directly select the students numbered 1 to 5
Write only the numbers 1 to 10 on slips of paper and draw 5 slips
Write each of the 50 numbers on a separate slip of paper of the same size and shape, mix them thoroughly, and randomly draw 5 slips

question.prompt: To select 5 students from 50 students numbered 1 to 50, how should the method of drawing lots be carried out? Which of the following procedures is correct?

solutions.explanation: Drawing lots requires a slip for every individual, identical slips that are thoroughly mixed, and random selection. This gives everyone an equal chance of being selected.
solutions.title: Check the requirements for drawing lots
